description: Command center for an aging parent: today's agenda, who's covering what, meds, tasks, bills.
notes: Med/task checklists persist in localStorage; progress bars derive from state
shared/kit.js + kit.css empty at build time; full Kit fallback inlined

notes.note: Caring for an aging parent over text threads is a distributed-ops nightmare everyone recognizes, and $14.99/mo from adult children is a price that clears without a committee. Land via families, expand to agencies — that's a real go-to-market. One of the strongest consumer plays in the batch.
Command center agenda/tasks; task check toggles counters, zero errors.
Normalized score schema: iteration-2 worker used thesis/magic_moment/demo_legibility/value_prop/ceiling; mapped to startup/originality/quality/usefulness/tech respectively.
